description: In the language with just \(0\) and \(s\), each closed term is \(s^n(0)\) for some natural number \(n\), and its value in the natural-number structure is \(n\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.LogicalCompactness.closed_terms_are_numerals
  (t : Lemmatheca.Entry.LogicalCompactness.successorLanguage.Term Empty) :
  ∃ n, t = Lemmatheca.Entry.LogicalCompactness.numeral n ∧ FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim t = n
